card.name: Words just before "ear"
card.fires_on: Small linking or describing words (each, your, affected, outer, his, the) right before the word ear or ears. It also fires on parts of ear-related words like otic and overhearing.

modes.label: Before ear
modes.description: A determiner or adjective sitting right before ear or ears, often in ear drop directions or earplug advice.
modes.example: Instill the contents of one single-dose CLOTIC vial into the<< affected>> ear canal twice daily, morning and evening

modes.label: Inside ear-related words
modes.description: Partway through a word that means ear or hearing, such as otic or overhearing.
modes.example: Cortisporin ® TC<< O>>tic should be used cautiously in any patient

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word ear or ears next, and away from unrelated word pieces.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before "ear", when the text is about to say ear.
